newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 50 billion dong ($4.54 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the central State Bank of Vietnam said on Monday.
At the last sale of government paper, on August 28, the central bank issued 100 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 8.60 percent.
There have been several sales of Treasury stock so far this year. The central bank is aiming to hold one auction every two weeks to lay the ground for a secondary market.

Vietnamese interest rates have fallen dramatically this year, partly due to a surplus of dong liquidity in the banking system. Bankers, noting that the coupon on Treasury notes rose by 0.30 percentage point at the last auction from the previous sale, said rates may have bottomed out.
